sloka: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे ।किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः ।। ५.३९.२७।।।।
transliteration: tadasmin kāryaniryoge vīraivaṁ duratikrame ।kiṁ paśyasi samādhānaṁ tvaṁ hi kāryavidāṁ varaḥ ।। 5.39.27।।।।

translations.english: "What means do you, being the foremost hero among the three who are capable performing this difficult task, foresee?
